name: SplitButton
summary: Two joined buttons: a primary action and a menu button that opens related alternatives. Use it when one action is the usual choice but others belong beside it, as in Save with Save as; use a menu button when there is no default action.

inputs.name: primaryActionButton
inputs.description: The button that runs the default action; its label is the SplitButton's children.

inputs.name: menuButton
inputs.description: The menu button half; place the SplitButton in a MenuTrigger and pass the trigger props here.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: As button; applied to both halves.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: As button; applied to both halves.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: As button; only the group's outer corners are rounded.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: As button, on the primary action.

inputs.name: iconPosition
inputs.description: As button, on the primary action.

anatomy.name: Group
anatomy.description: An inline-flex wrapper holding both halves side by side, aligned to the text's middle.

anatomy.name: Primary action button
anatomy.description: A button with square end corners; its end border is the divider between the halves.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.description: The primary action's end border: Stroke 1 on secondary and outline, StrokeOnBrand on primary, invisible on subtle and transparent.

anatomy.name: Menu button
anatomy.description: A menu button with no start border and square start corners, at least 24px wide.

variants.description: Each half as a secondary button; the divider is the primary action's colorNeutralStroke1 end border, stepping with button's border on hover and press.
As secondary: the file adds nothing.
The divider is colorNeutralStrokeOnBrand at rest, hover and press, so a light line splits the brand fill.
The divider reads colorTransparentBackground, Hover and Pressed, so no line shows between the halves.
As button on the outer corners; the file declares no shape classes of its own.

layout.text: The root is a relatively positioned inline-flex row, stretched, aligned vertical-middle with surrounding text.

The primary action loses its top-end and bottom-end radii; the menu button loses its start border and its top-start and bottom-start radii, so the two share one border line: the primary action's end border.
The menu button's minimum width drops from button's 64 or 96px to 24px, the WCAG minimum for adjacent targets; with only its menu icon it lays out square, as an icon-only button.
Each half is otherwise a button (primary action) and a menu button (menu half) with the group's appearance, size and shape.

states.text: Rest: the divider is the primary action's end border in the appearance's colour; each half's own states are as button and menu button.

Hovering either half hovers the group: on primary the divider stays colorNeutralStrokeOnBrand, on subtle and transparent it reads colorTransparentBackgroundHover; on secondary and outline it follows the primary action's own hover border only when that half is hovered.
Pressing reads colorNeutralStrokeOnBrand on primary and colorTransparentBackgroundPressed on subtle and transparent.
Each half draws button's inset colorStrokeFocus2 ring on its own, and the ring keeps the half's squared inner corners and the menu button's missing start border.
Disabled (or disabledFocusable) turns the divider colorNeutralStrokeDisabled in every state; the halves are as a disabled button.

behaviour.text: Clicking the primary action, or Enter or Space on it, runs onClick; it does not open the menu.
The menu half opens the menu as a menu button does; the SplitButton is wrapped in a MenuTrigger whose props reach the menu half.
The halves are two tab stops, primary action first.

keyboard: Tab moves to the primary action, then the menu half
Enter or Space on the primary action runs it
Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the menu half opens the menu
semantics: two buttons; the menu half reports aria-haspopup menu and aria-expanded
give the menu half an aria-label such as More options, since it shows only a chevron

notes.text: The menu half's 24px minimum width is a constant (MIN_TARGET_SIZE) in the styles file.

Subtle and transparent colour the divider with background tokens (colorTransparentBackground and its Hover and Pressed), not strokes; the effect is no divider. Draw nothing there rather than looking for a stroke token.
The divider is set as borderRightColor and the menu half's borderLeftWidth; these are physical sides, and in right-to-left layouts they must be mirrored (Griffel flips them automatically).

Under forced colours the primary appearance's divider is HighlightText at rest and Highlight on hover and press, and a disabled group's divider is GrayText; the halves follow button's forced-colours rules.
